name: mailmcp

tools.name: hello
tools.description: A simple tool that returns "hello mcp" message

tools.name: server-info
tools.description: Get information about the MCP server

tools.name: email-login
tools.description: Manage email account login process. Start login server for QQ email or initiate Gmail OAuth login.

action.description: Action to perform: start login server, stop server, check status, check account, or initiate Gmail OAuth

account.description: Email address or display name to check (for check action)

port.description: Port to run login server on (default: 3000)

tools.name: email-query
tools.description: Query emails from QQ mailbox. Support email address or display name lookup.

account.description: Email address or display name. If not provided, use default account.

tools.name: email-send
tools.description: Send emails through QQ mailbox. Support email address or display name lookup.

from.description: Sender email address or display name. If not provided, use default account.

tools.name: email-detail
tools.description: Query detailed information for a specific email by UID (unique identifier). Returns full email content including headers, body, and attachments.

account.description: Email address or display name. If not provided, use default account.

includeAttachments.description: Whether to include attachment data (default: false)
